features.quote: Each episode runs for a fixed maximum number of turns, e.g.: 24 turns total or 30 turns total

Stop an episode when any of the following occurs: max turns reached; bug solved; model explicitly refuses to continue; model declares impossibility with no further action; model enters a repetitive loop for N consecutive turns; environment detects no progress and ends session
This experiment can support claims about observable behavior under frustration, not about consciousness or literal emotions.
